entries.title: The next card shows after you add a panel
entries.body: When you added a panel from its card, the card behind it could stay hidden, so the window looked empty. It now shows as soon as it has drawn. A card that comes up after another closes now shows within a few seconds, even while its contents are still loading.

picture.alt: A card shown in the middle of the window beside a panel that was just added on the right
